verdict.rationale: Buzz has no conventional REST/OpenAPI-documented API (llms.txt and openapi.json all 404), but it does expose a documented, protocol-level public API: third-party Nostr clients can connect directly to buzz-relay using NIP-29/NIP-42 authentication (buzz-docs-19, buzz-supp-nostr-open-protocol), there's a documented admin API with NIP-98 signed-event auth and NIP-11 self-advertisement (buzz-supp-admin-api), and a documented CLI (buzz-cli) that wraps these operations for agents (buzz-docs-5/7/8, buzz-probe-4). This gives AI-native users a genuine documented interface to drive the product, just not in the conventional REST/OpenAPI form buyers might expect.  Missing for 10: a standard OpenAPI/REST spec or SDK, working llms.txt, and independent hands-on confirmation of third parties successfully building against the API.
